scope: Manual validation plan for the experimental C playback interface (public-api.md) via airplay2-api-host, plus one cast CLI run with a user-provided remuxed film for E-AC-3 audio and seeking past 4 GiB. First receiver runs on the D47 teardown runtime. Observer answers are recorded separately from protocol results.

receiver.name: Living Room
receiver.firmware_scope: Prior user report, assumed unchanged; not queried during this test.

binaries.staging: Each tested executable (and the shared DLL) was copied to a path with an existing inbound firewall rule and the original restored afterwards with SHA-256 equality. No firewall, network, credential or receiver setting changed.

clip.description: H.264/AAC MP4, about 131.6 s (the established test clip)

film.description: User-provided feature film, remuxed by the user from MKV with ffmpeg stream copy; personally held, not committed. H.264 High level 4.0 1920x802 23.976 fps (avc1); E-AC-3 5.1 48 kHz (ec-3, dec3 Atmos extension flag set, complexity index 16); mov_text subtitles; moov before mdat; 64-bit co64 chunk offsets.
